registry.description: Heart (lev / kardia) is the most frequently referenced seat of the inner life in the entire biblical corpus — the Hebrew lev and its Greek equivalent kardia carrying a meaning far wider than our word heart. It is the centre of thought, decision, desire, will, emotion, and moral orientation: to think in one's heart, to set one's heart on something, to have a hard heart or a tender heart, to speak from the heart. The heart is the inner person in their totality, which is why the command to love God with all your heart is the command that encompasses everything else.
